system.description:
In order to cast this spell, you must sprinkle a powdered diamond on the target.

Choose one object in range that is currently under the effects of a spell you have cast. The duration of that spell becomes 1 year.

You cannot alter the original spell’s effects after casting permanence. For instance, you can no longer move an object under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.AZo6rYWOo0SHvpxZ]{telekinesis}.
